answer: The ripple is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. By the pigment of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
